summary: How a vacancy is filled depends on the city's charter, with a deadline for the council to act.
realLife: Tennessee guidance says a city should check its charter and gives the council a window to fill a seat.
sources: Tennessee MTAS, filling city council vacancies: https://mtas.tennessee.edu/reference/filling-city-council-vacancies
